string-array.name: help_g_download_steps
string-array.item: In the video app, tap Share, then Copy link.
In Fetchy, tap Paste.
Pick a quality.
Tap Download.

string-array.name: help_g_playlist_steps
string-array.item: Paste a playlist link and tap Download.
Tick the videos you want.
Pick one quality, then tap Download.
If some fail, tap \"Retry failed\" at the end.

string-array.name: help_g_login_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings.
Tap \"YouTube login\" or \"Instagram login\".
Sign in, then tap Done.
Login page blocked? Tap \"Import cookies.txt\" and pick the file from Downloads.

string-array.name: help_g_find_steps
string-array.item: Open the Files (or My Files) app.
Open Downloads. Playlists have their own folder there.
Or tap \"Download history\" in Fetchy.

string-array.name: help_g_tools_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings.
Tap \"Update tools\".
Wait for the new version number.

string-array.name: help_p_yt_bot_fix
string-array.item: Turn off any VPN or proxy.
Tap \"Log in\" and sign in to YouTube.
Google blocks the login? Use \"Import cookies.txt\" instead.
Tap \"Retry\".

string-array.name: help_p_yt_unavail_fix
string-array.item: Open the link in your browser. If it does not play there, Fetchy cannot get it.
For adults only: tap \"Log in\" with an adult account, then \"Retry\".
Removed or private: only the owner can fix that.

string-array.name: help_p_ig_login_fix
string-array.item: Tap \"Log in\" and sign in.
Tap Done. Fetchy tries again by itself.
No login page? Use \"Import cookies.txt\".

string-array.name: help_p_ig_empty_fix
string-array.item: Tap \"Log in\", then \"Retry\".
Check that the post is a video or a Reel.
Wait a few minutes, then try again.

string-array.name: help_p_ig_private_fix
string-array.item: Open the link in your browser. If you cannot see it, Fetchy cannot either.
Private: log in with an account that can see it, then tap \"Retry\".
Deleted: it is gone for good.

string-array.name: help_p_g_unsupported_fix
string-array.item: Use the video\'s Share button, then Copy link.
Paste the whole link. It starts with https://
Photos do not work. Fetchy downloads videos.

string-array.name: help_p_g_ffmpeg_fix
string-array.item: Tap \"Retry\".
Free some storage space on your phone.
Open Settings and tap \"Update tools\".

string-array.name: help_p_g_network_fix
string-array.item: Check that the internet works in your browser.
Turn off VPN and Private DNS.
Wait a few minutes, then tap \"Retry\".
Try the other network (Wi-Fi or mobile data).

string-array.name: help_p_g_update_fix
string-array.item: Open Settings and tap \"Update tools\".
Wait for the new version number.
Go back and tap \"Retry\".

string-array.name: help_p_g_format_fix
string-array.item: Open Settings and tap \"Update tools\".
Tap \"Log in\", or see \"Log in to YouTube or Instagram\".
Tap \"Retry\".
